description: Create src/v2/ as a full COPY of the src/v1/ tree, then rename EVERYTHING from V1 to V2 so the v2/ tree is a fully self-consistent, independently-compiling V2 copy: file names, contract names, interface names, library names, struct/type names, event/error names, constants, all intra-tree import references, and version-carrying string literals and comments. The v2 tree must import only from within src/v2/ (and external remapped deps) - never from src/v1/. Depends on FEAT-001. VERIFIED PRECONDITION: every occurrence of the token `V1` and lowercase `v1` in these source files is RetroPick protocol versioning (no non-RetroPick V1/v1 uses exist), so a whole-tree `V1`->`V2` and `v1`->`v2` token replacement is safe and complete. Do NOT touch Uniswap's `V4`/`v4` naming.
steps: Copy the entire tree: `cp -r src/v1 src/v2` producing src/v2/, src/v2/hooks/, src/v2/interfaces/, src/v2/libraries/ with V1-named files.

Rename the 15 files in src/v2/ from *V1.sol to *V2.sol using git mv (or mv): RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol->RetroPickBondingCurveV2.sol, RetroPickBuybackVaultV1.sol->RetroPickBuybackVaultV2.sol, RetroPickDoorwayV1.sol->RetroPickDoorwayV2.sol, RetroPickGraduationExecutorV1.sol->RetroPickGraduationExecutorV2.sol, RetroPickGraduationGuardV1.sol->RetroPickGraduationGuardV2.sol, RetroPickLaunchDeployerV1.sol->RetroPickLaunchDeployerV2.sol, RetroPickLaunchFactoryV1.sol->RetroPickLaunchFactoryV2.sol, RetroPickLaunchLockerV1.sol->RetroPickLaunchLockerV2.sol, RetroPickLauncherTokenV1.sol->RetroPickLauncherTokenV2.sol, hooks/RetroPickMemeHookV1.sol->hooks/RetroPickMemeHookV2.sol, interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV1.sol->interfaces/IRetroPickDoorwayV2.sol, interfaces/IRetroPickGraduationV1.sol->interfaces/IRetroPickGraduationV2.sol, interfaces/IRetroPickLaunchpadV1.sol->interfaces/IRetroPickLaunchpadV2.sol, libraries/RetroPickBondingCurveMathV1.sol->libraries/RetroPickBondingCurveMathV2.sol, libraries/RetroPickGraduationMathV1.sol->libraries/RetroPickGraduationMathV2.sol.

Inside EVERY file under src/v2/ ONLY, replace the token `V1` with `V2` and the token `v1` with `v2`. This is scoped strictly to files under src/v2/ - do not modify src/v1/ or test/ in this feature. This single rename covers all symbol categories at once: contract/interface/library/struct names (e.g. RetroPickDoorwayV1->RetroPickDoorwayV2, IRetroPickFeeEscrowV1->IRetroPickFeeEscrowV2, RetroPickBondingCurveMathV1->RetroPickBondingCurveMathV2, IRetroPickLaunchFactoryGraduationV1->IRetroPickLaunchFactoryGraduationV2), relative import references in the v2 files (which after rename point to the V2-named sibling files - e.g. `./libraries/RetroPickBondingCurveMathV2.sol`, `../RetroPickBuybackVaultV2.sol`), revert/require string literals that embed the version (e.g. "RetroPickDoorwayV1: not owner" -> "RetroPickDoorwayV2: not owner"), any event/error/constant names embedding V1, and version-carrying comments/doc titles (@title RetroPick...V2, `one v1 launch` -> `one v2 launch`, `RetroPick V1 architecture` -> `RetroPick V2 architecture`). A recommended approach: apply a scoped sed over files under src/v2 replacing `V1`->`V2` then `v1`->`v2`, since verification confirmed all such tokens are RetroPick versioning. After sed, grep src/v2 for any residual `V1`/`v1` and manually confirm none remain.

Confirm the v2 tree is self-referential: grep -rn `src/v1` and `V1` and `v1` inside src/v2/ and confirm ZERO matches (no leftover V1 symbols, no imports crossing into the v1 tree). Every relative import inside src/v2 must resolve to another src/v2 file or an external remapped dep.

Confirm no NAME collisions between src/v1 and src/v2: because all v1 contracts/interfaces/libraries are V1-suffixed and all v2 ones are V2-suffixed, the compiler's global namespace has no duplicate contract names. Verify by building the whole tree.

Preserve every rationale comment and any existing `// forge-lint: disable-next-line(...)` suppression lines in the v2 copy (they carry over verbatim except for the V1->V2 token in adjacent identifiers/strings). Do not delete or reformat justification comments.
Build the full tree (v1 + v2 compiled together) with --force and confirm zero errors and zero warnings.
acceptance_criteria: src/v2/ exists with 15 files all named *V2.sol in the same subfolder layout as src/v1/.
grep -rnE 'V1|v1' src/v2 returns ZERO matches (fully renamed to V2/v2).
grep -rn 'src/v1' src/v2 returns ZERO matches (v2 never imports from v1).
Every contract/interface/library in src/v2 is V2-suffixed; no name collides with a src/v1 V1-suffixed symbol.
`forge build --force` compiles the combined v1+v2 tree with ZERO errors.
src/v1/ and test/ are unchanged by this feature (only src/v2/ was added/edited).
verification: grep -rnE 'V1|v1' src/v2 || echo 'clean: no V1/v1 remaining' (must be clean)
grep -rn 'src/v1' src/v2 || echo 'clean: no cross-tree imports' (must be clean)
forge test (must still show the baseline count passing - v1 tests unaffected)
findings: Copied src/v1 -> src/v2 (cp -r), then git mv renamed all 15 files *V1.sol -> *V2.sol preserving the hooks/interfaces/libraries subfolder layout. Applied a scoped sed over files under src/v2 ONLY: s/V1/V2/g then s/v1/v2/g. Verified the precondition first: the only lines containing both v1/V1 and V4 are RetroPick versioning next to Uniswap V4 references (position/hook/pool), and no V1/v1 token belongs to Uniswap - so the token rename is safe and left all Uniswap V4/v4 naming untouched (confirmed post-sed). No V22/v22 double-replacement artifacts. All relative imports in src/v2 now resolve to V2-named siblings within src/v2 (grep 'src/v1' returns zero). All 72 pre-existing '// forge-lint: disable-next-line(...)' suppression comments carried over verbatim; only adjacent V1 identifiers/strings changed. VERIFICATION PASSED: grep -rnE 'V1|v1' src/v2 = clean; grep -rn 'src/v1' src/v2 = clean; `forge build --force` exits 0 with no errors and no name collisions (v1+v2 compile together, 127 files); `forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -cE '^warning\[' = 0; `forge test` = 45 passed / 0 failed (baseline unchanged). Two solc Warning(2018) 'state mutability can be restricted to view' appear on RetroPickBondingCurveV1.sol:813 (pre-existing at HEAD) and its faithful copy RetroPickBondingCurveV2.sol:813 (exemptFromSnipeTax) - these are NOT counted by the ^warning\[ forge-lint metric and were intentionally left unchanged to keep v2 a faithful copy. Scope respected: only src/v2/ files added/edited; src/v1/ and test/ untouched by this feature (any src/v1|test working-tree changes shown by git predate FEAT-002). Left staged, not committed.
